project_info.theme: Colorful Y2K scrapbook poster with repeated adult fashion portraits
project_info.creative_direction: Chaotic yet balanced frameless collage combining pastel styling, stickers, holographic textures, and magazine cutouts
project_info.color_palette: pastel lilac, pink, mint, butter yellow, white, holographic rainbow, and neon outline accents

main_subject.detail: same approved adult woman across every cutout with wavy dark brown hair, bubblegum-pink lower strands, pastel flower clips, and a cute-cool expression
main_subject.wardrobe: cropped oversized pastel sweater with embroidered patches, pastel skirt with white belt, white ankle socks with pastel stripes, white sneakers, colorful bracelets, rings, and a subtle decorative waist chain
main_subject.poses: heart-finger close-up, crouched pose with chin supported and white instant camera, cheek-touching bubblegum portrait, smiling cat portrait, seated peace sign, and daisy bouquet portrait

composition_elements.framing: multi-cutout portrait collage with central full-body anchor and surrounding close, mid, and seated crops
composition_elements.graphics: holographic textures, pastel gradients, glitter accents, playful doodles, Polaroid frames, neon outlines, stickers, and balanced magazine cutout text such as SO CUTE!, 199X!, and GIRL VIBES
composition_elements.layout: frameless scrapbook arrangement with colorful strokes, lines, hearts, stars, butterflies, and deliberate negative-space rhythm

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft on-camera flash at approximately 5200K with pastel ambient fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: glossy dreamy retro glow, clean skin texture, controlled holographic sparkle, and crisp collage edges

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame fashion photography with 35mm lens combined with graphic scrapbook compositing
technical_specs.finish: high-detail photoreal cutouts, natural facial consistency, restrained grain, vivid pastel color, and stable anatomy

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a colorful Y2K scrapbook poster featuring the same clearly adult woman repeated across multiple fashion poses and cutouts. Give her wavy dark brown hair with bubblegum-pink tint on the lower strands, pastel flower clips, and a cute-cool confident expression. Dress her in a cropped oversized pastel sweater with embroidered patches, pastel skirt with white belt, white ankle socks with colorful pastel stripes, white sneakers, colorful plastic bracelets, chunky rings, and a subtle decorative waist chain. Include a close-up with heart-shape fingers, a full-body crouching pose supporting the chin while holding a white instant camera, a mid-shot touching the cheek while chewing a bubblegum bubble, a smiling portrait holding a cat, a seated peace-sign pose, and a mid-shot holding daisy flowers. Use holographic textures, pastel gradients, glitter accents, doodles, Polaroid frames, neon outlines, magazine cutout graphics, and balanced text such as SO CUTE!, 199X!, and GIRL VIBES. Use soft approximately 5200K flash, a glossy dreamy retro glow, high-detail photoreal cutouts, and stable anatomy. Keep every subject clearly adult and the poses non-sexual.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike styling, suggestive pout, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed limbs, face mismatch, broken collage, illegible text
